canonical_name: Finite complex Schur triangularization theorem family
literal_source_claim_en: A complex square matrix can be unitarily triangularized.
canonical_statement: For every natural number n and every n by n complex matrix A, there is a unitary matrix U such that star U times A times U is upper triangular.
canonical_claim: Every finite complex square matrix is unitarily similar to an upper triangular matrix.
